creator: Alexander Terp
description:
MIP-10 stage 2, part 2 of 3: messages, acting as the human. Read docs/mip/0010-api-for-other-tools.md sections 5 and 7.

What: post and answer a question through the API, as `muster msg post` does, acting as the human unless the request names another participant; each post records the client's name, and the conversation and `muster msg log` show it beside the author: `Alex (@human) via foreman` (decided, question D). `msg.ack`: moves the human's place in a group to a given number at the human's home if further on, never back; fetching, replying and dismissing acknowledge nothing; `muster msg read` keeps reading to the end. Today read takes only a group and moves to the head (crates/muster-msg/src/service.rs).

Proves: a phone-like gate client that acknowledges #10 while #11 arrives leaves #11 unread at the desk; the desk and the client answering one question at once leaves one answer (the home refuses the second); the banner and the conversation show "via".
title: MIP-10 stage 2b: posting as the human via a client, and msg.ack
